release_ready_rationale: LAYER_4_LEAN_CONCORDANCE is UNVERIFIABLE in this repository. An undischargeable layer blocks release exactly as a violated one does; it is reported distinctly because it calls for different work, not because it is a pass.

criteria.statement: Every historical episode replays byte-identically, and a mutation names the episode and the offset.
criteria.decisive_mutation: Alter one byte of one recorded vector.

criteria.statement: Each verification layer fails independently; a fault at layer k is reported as layer k.
criteria.decisive_mutation: Collapse two layers into one report.

criteria.statement: The epic manifest audit passes on the real repository against the shared EXPECTED_EPIC_COUNT.
criteria.decisive_mutation: Add a plan file without regenerating the manifest.

criteria.statement: Four-host parity is verified inside this gate rather than as a separate manual step.
criteria.decisive_mutation: Edit one host's copy of a skill.

criteria.statement: Every dossier claim names its discharging test; a claim with no discharge is recorded as an open obligation.
criteria.decisive_mutation: Remove a test named by the dossier.

open_obligations.detail: lean4/ is a pointer to the CODA estate and declares no Lake manifest, so there is no proof to elaborate against here. Recorded rather than omitted: an omitted claim reads as an absent obligation instead of an open one.
open_obligations.discharge_condition: A Lake project is vendored here, or the gate is given a CODA checkout to elaborate against. verify_lean_concordance already refuses to self-certify if a manifest appears.

open_obligations.detail: test_module 'pfp/tests/test_symbol_game_release_gate.py' has been relocated from ms_majorana and verified in canonical pfp/tests/.
open_obligations.discharge_condition: Implement or relocate the test suite into an active repository path (e.g. pfp/tests/).

notes: Recorded during sprint 028. Every pre-existing epic-manifest test ran against a tmp_path fixture, so a real drift -- an epic plan file edited without the manifest being regenerated -- reached origin/main undetected. Criterion 3's claims audit the real repository.
AuthorityEffect: None. This dossier records evidence; it does not promote anything. Promotion requires the human's own authorization.
